M9_Matched_Placebo.interpretation: Placebo non-event dates for the same ticker produce a mean peer excess return of +0.55% (vs +0.65% for real disclosure dates, delta = +0.10 pp, p = 0.4600). This indicates that ticker-level momentum and exposure characteristics account for most of the forward return, while the precise event timing provides a modest incremental lift (+0.10 pp).

M10_Accumulation_Placebo.interpretation: Stocks in an accumulation regime without disclosure events exhibit a mean peer excess of +-0.13%, compared to +0.65% when disclosure is present (delta = +0.79 pp). This supports the interpretation of disclosure as a confirmation marker within accumulation regimes.
